Pune activist arrested for alleged derogatory remarks

An activist in Pune was arrested for allegedly making derogatory remarks about a minister and a corporator. The specific nature of the remarks and the identities of the minister and corporator were not detailed in the coverage. The arrest was made following a complaint. The activist's name was not provided in the reports. The incident occurred in Pune.
